attributes.board_name: Hawaii Department of Commerce and Consumer Affairs, Professional and Vocational Licensing Division (Marriage and Family Therapist Program)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses approved by AAMFT, Hawaiian Islands Association for Marriage and Family Therapy, APA, Hawaii Psychological Association, NASW or NBCC and affiliates; credit hour = 50 minutes
rules.new_licensee_rule: First-time licensees are exempt from CE for the first renewal.
rules.audit_note: Licensees keep their own CE records and present proof if audited by DCCA.
rules.notes: All licenses renew triennially by December 31 regardless of issue date (2025, 2028, 2031). Associate MFT provisional licenses do not require CE. Licensed by the DCCA Director (no board).
